nx-free-authoring-core.rule: libs/authoring/src/**/*.ts contains zero imports of '@nx/devkit' or any '@nx/*' package — the scaffold(opts)->FileSet core is pure so `sox init` works without nx installed

scaffold-parity.rule: a passing test asserts scaffold() called directly (sox init path) and via @adhd/sox-nx:extension emit byte-identical FileSet output for identical inputs — the two authoring paths can never drift

nx-never-runtime-dep.rule: no extension or lib package.json lists 'nx' or any '@nx/*' under 'dependencies' — nx appears only under the root devDependencies

manifest-single-source.rule: validate(manifest) is exported only from libs/manifest; scripts/validate-manifests.ts imports it rather than re-implementing schema logic — one source of truth for 'conformant'

no-cross-extension-reachin.rule: no file under extensions/ imports another extension's built output via a relative '../**/dist/' path — shared code is imported from a libs/* internal library and the @nx/enforce-module-boundaries rule forbids extension->extension edges

dual-flag-form.rule: the CLI argument parser accepts BOTH `--flag value` and `--flag=value` forms for every flag, matching the documented --help output (A12)

self-hosted-extension-zero.rule: apps/sox ships its own extension.json with type 'command' that validates against libs/manifest's validate() — sox is a literal conformant extension #0 (D1/D2)
